The '''''Scarlet Vertha''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|720 light freighter]] owned by [[Nabrun Leids/Legends|Nabrun Leids]]. It was custom made by the [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerian]] and was said by other [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to have never been held by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for inspection. The ''Scarlet Vertha'' was damaged by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] after Leids never paid him for calling off all [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on Lieds.

The ''Scarlet Vertha''{{'s}} [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system provided a [[Methane/Legends|methane]]-only [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Leids's crew consisted of two [[Morseerian/Legends|Morseerians]], a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]], and a [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]].
